Forest Rising.name: Forest Rising
Forest Rising.description: The user's signature move: they plant both hands and a stand of trunks and vines bursts up through soil and pavement across a street-wide area. Every enemy caught in the growth takes massive bludgeoning damage and is held aloft in coiled vines, unable to move until they tear free with a hard effort or are cut loose, while allies are lifted clear of danger; afterward the user cannot grow anything until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.
